title: Easy Fried French Mitsuba Fritters
description: A lazy Sunday French dish featuring mitsuba, deep-fried to a golden brown, low-fat friendly version of a classic French fritter. Perfect for a relaxing weekend meal.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: 1/2 inch deep in a frying pan

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, eggs, milk, melted butter, salt, and pepper to make a smooth batter.
Add the chopped mitsuba to the batter and stir until well combined.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat to 350 degrees.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mitsuba batter into the hot oil, being careful not to overcrowd the pan.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and puffed up.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining batter.
Keep the fried fritters warm in a low oven while frying the remaining batter.
